correctness.rationale: All feasible moves either stay in one part (zero utility and potential changes) or cross parts. In the cross-class case both increments are \(x/(a-1)-(y-1)/(b-1)\) by the binomial pair-count difference; the mirror case is symmetric. Therefore the potential is exact. The bounds \(0\leq\Phi\leq(a+b-2)/2\) and lattice spacing \(1/\operatorname{lcm}(a-1,b-1)\) give the step bound for every finite graph and every strict improvement sequence. Extracted standalone code checked 658,040 exact rational transition identities in six small instance families. Requiring \(a,b\geq2\) avoids zero denominators.

value.rationale: Closes a natural nonregular, cyclic complete-bipartite subfamily under an explicit bipartite-topology question in the originating paper. The exact cardinality-normalized potential and all-schedules \(O(N^3)\) improvement bound are structural rather than a narrow numerically chosen example. It covers arbitrary type counts and immobile subsets. It neither purports to solve all bipartite topologies nor multiple vacancies.
